article.headline: GitLab Falls 6.5% As Revenue Growth Holds At 21.3% Pace
article.deck: The October breakout from a 55.65 buy point has stalled; at 48.99 the stock is 12.0% under it and below its 50-day line, so there is no entry now.
body: GitLab fell 3.38 to 48.99, a 6.5% loss, and closed below its 50-day line at 50.87. The stock broke out of a five-week cup, 20.4% deep, past a 55.65 buy point on Oct. 12; the buy range ran to 58.43. It now sits 12.0% under the buy point, a stalled breakout. Volume was 0.77x its 50-day average.

The stock is 15.5% off its 52-week high of 58.01 and 3.7% below the 50-day. The 21-day line is at 53.19, 7.9% above the close, and the session's high stayed under it: 0.49 ATRs from the 21-day line. The 200-day line at 34.41 is 42.4% below. GitLab holds an RS rank of 93 of 99 on the desk's list, though the RS line is 11.0% off its high. The stock is up 30.5% this year and 5.4% over twelve months.

The quarter ended July 31 showed a loss of 0.22 a share on revenue of $286.3 million, up 21.3% from a year earlier. Revenue has risen each quarter in the table, from $244.4 million in the October 2025 quarter to $260.4 million, $264.2 million and $286.3 million, while the company posted losses in all four. The next report is due Dec. 1. Market value is $8.16 billion, at 47.18 times forward earnings.
An Insider Monkey headline says GitLab eased AI disruption fears after exceptional Q2 results, citing the Madison Small Cap Fund. A Trefis piece asks whether the stock can get back to where it was.
A close back above the 50-day line would repair part of the damage; a new attempt at the 55.65 buy point would come after that.
article.watch: Watch the 50-day line at 50.87 and the Dec. 1 earnings report.

article.headline: Tesla Falls 10.8% As Democratic Sweep Clouds SpaceX Merger Prospects
article.deck: The late-October breakout past 386.93 has failed; at 343.69 the stock is 11.2% below the buy point and under the base's own low.
body: Tesla dropped 41.50 to 343.69, a 10.8% loss, on volume 2.06x its 50-day average. The stock broke out of a four-week flat base, 10.6% deep, past a 386.93 buy point on Oct. 26, with a buy range up to 406.28. Eight sessions later it closed 11.2% below the buy point and under the base's low of 345.88. That flat base formed inside a bigger correction, and the stock remains well under the 498.83 high from Dec. 22, 2025.

Shares are 31.1% off that 52-week high. Tesla closed 7.6% below its 50-day line at 372.07 and 10.6% below its 200-day at 384.32. The 21-day line is at 381.75, and the session's high stayed under it: 0.46 ATRs from the 21-day line. The RS rank is 43 of 99 on the desk's list and the RS line is 35.1% off its high. The stock is down 23.6% this year and 22.6% over twelve months.

The September quarter brought earnings of 0.22 a share, down 43.6% from a year earlier, on revenue of $28.05 billion, down 0.2%. Earnings over the four quarters shown ran 0.24, 0.13, 0.32 and 0.22. The next report is due Jan. 27, 2027. Tesla is valued at $1.36 trillion, 159.17 times forward earnings.

Yahoo Finance reported that SpaceX and Tesla stocks tumbled as a Democratic sweep raised questions on merger prospects and the AI build-out. A separate Yahoo Finance headline said stocks slid as Wall Street's post-election rally fizzled.
With the stock under both the 50-day and 200-day lines, the chart needs a new base before a buy point means anything.
article.watch: Watch whether the stock can retake the base low at 345.88 or keeps sliding toward the 297.38 low of July 29.

article.headline: Palantir Drops 9.7% As Wall Street Dumps Software's AI Winners
article.deck: The October breakout from a 47-week deep cup past 207.62 has unwound; at 154.99 the stock is 25.3% below the buy point and well under its 50-day line.
body: Palantir fell 16.71 to 154.99, a 9.7% loss, on volume 1.92x its 50-day average. The stock broke out of a 47-week deep cup, 48.7% from top to bottom, past a 207.62 buy point on Oct. 9; the buy range ran to 218.00. Nineteen sessions later it trades 25.3% below the buy point, a stalled breakout that has given back the whole move.

Shares are 27.2% off the 52-week high of 212.94. Palantir closed 16.8% below both its 21-day line at 186.25 and its 50-day line at 186.39, and the session's high stayed under the 21-day: 1.96 ATRs from the 21-day line. The 200-day line at 153.56 sits just 0.9% below the close. The RS rank is 40 of 99 on the desk's list, the RS line is 25.6% off its high, and the stock is down 20.2% in a month and 12.8% this year.

The business has not slowed. September-quarter earnings rose 144.4% to 0.44 a share and revenue grew 95.9% to $2.31 billion. Earnings climbed in each quarter shown, from 0.24 to 0.34, 0.41 and 0.44, and revenue from $1.41 billion to $1.63 billion, $1.94 billion and $2.31 billion. The next report is due Feb. 1, 2027. The company is valued at $373.4 billion, 62.48 times forward earnings.

Yahoo Finance reported that Palantir and CrowdStrike stocks tumbled as Wall Street dumped software's AI winners. A 24/7 Wall St. headline noted Palantir just had its best growth quarter ever and asked why investors are selling.
A break of the 200-day line would put the stock below every major average.
